hook: Bunsen burners do not sterilize lab workspaces and can worsen contamination.
what_happened: Researchers tested Bunsen burners by contaminating lab air with bacteria and measuring how many microbes settled near active versus inactive burners.
why_it_matters: This challenges the long-held assumption that Bunsen burner convection currents carry microbe-containing particles away from workbenches.
the_catch: Only one extreme experiment with massive bacteria levels showed fewer bacteria settling near the active burner.
caption: A new study reveals that laboratory Bunsen burners fail to effectively decontaminate workspaces and may even increase bacterial contamination.
alt_text: A five-slide carousel explaining a study that found Bunsen burners do not decontaminate lab workspaces and can increase bacterial contamination, except when airborne contamination is extremely high.

es.hook: Los quemadores Bunsen no esterilizan los espacios de trabajo de laboratorio y pueden empeorar la contaminación.
es.what_happened: Los investigadores probaron los quemadores Bunsen contaminando el aire del laboratorio con bacterias y midiendo cuántos microorganismos se depositaron cerca de quemadores activos versus inactivos.
es.why_it_matters: Esto cuestiona la suposición de larga data de que las corrientes de convección de los quemadores Bunsen alejan las partículas que contienen microorganismos de las mesas de trabajo.
es.the_catch: Solo un experimento extremo con niveles masivos de bacterias mostró menos bacterias depositadas cerca del quemador activo.
